name: infra-dify-ops
summary: Dify 平台使用层运维 Skill：DSL 创作/校验/双轨导入（Console API 优先，Playwright 兜底）、DSL 导出、app 检查、本地资源沉淀、workflow 草稿、模型 provider 配置与生产验收；不负责部署层。配套 CLI difyctl。
runtime_requirements: Use this skill for Dify app/workflow resource operations and DSL authoring at the usage layer, not for deployment or container lifecycle management.
Prefer `difyctl dsl import --via auto` (Console API first, Playwright fallback) over ad hoc manual clicking; only use `--via browser` when the API path is unavailable.
Always run `difyctl dsl validate` before importing a scaffolded or hand-edited DSL.
Prefer the local registry and workflow spec flow before introducing batch changes into Dify Studio.
Use database-level edits only as an explicitly approved break-glass recovery path when Studio or the imported graph is already unusable.
post_install_hints: Install the paired CLI difyctl and initialize a project workspace before using the resource capture commands.

integrations.contract: 发布/废弃/同步、bump 版本、lock 刷新
